about: Coming up: anything that is only true for a while (events, notices, requests for help, urgent messages). Each item shows from show_from until the day before hide_from (London time), in the homepage strip at the foot of the prayer banner, one at a time, and (if it has text or a poster) as a full post on coming-up.html. Optional per item: label = the strip tag, "Coming up" (default), "Notice", "Help needed" or "Important" (Important items show first and alone, in deep red); line = the strip's short second line, word for word (otherwise worked out from starts / ends / time: "This Sunday · 6–8pm", "Starts this Monday", "On now", "Open until …"); link = where tapping goes (absent: the full post; a URL such as tel:…, contact.html or https://… with link_label; null: nowhere). Keep the title to about 30 characters and the line to about 45 so both fit two lines on a phone. After an event, post the report to News (data/facebook-news-preview.json). Read by js/coming-up.js.

items.title: Youth Summer Retreat 2026
items.when: Monday 20 July to the final week of August 2026
items.place: Educational Centre, 46 Conway Road, London SE18 1AR (Monday–Thursday)
text: Greenwich Madina Trust’s six-week Youth Summer Retreat begins Monday 20 July, with Islamic learning, practical workshops and activities for boys and girls aged 5–16.
The programme runs Monday to Thursday until the final week of August. Children do not need to be enrolled at the Madrasah to take part.
Activities include learning about the life of Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ, a practical Ṣalāh workshop, selected aḥādīth and Islamic teachings, quizzes, stories, football, a planned trip and a barbecue.

There will be no Summer Retreat or Madrasah session at the Educational Centre on Fridays. Instead, young people are expected to attend the 1pm Jumuʿah at Ghousia Masjid, where a special English talk will be delivered for them.
Existing Madrasah students do not need to register for the retreat. Parents and carers of other children should call Greenwich Madina Trust to book a place.

items.title: What should our Friday youth talks be about?
text: As part of GMT’s Youth Summer Retreat, attendees aged 5–16 will join the 1pm Jumuʿah at Ghousia Masjid on Fridays for a special English talk.
GMT is asking young people, families and the wider community which topics would be most helpful for those talks this summer.
Young people can answer directly. Parents, carers and community members should respond with retreat attendees aged 5–16 in mind.
The questionnaire takes approximately two minutes to complete. No name or email is needed.

details.label: Who can respond
details.value: Young people and adults; adults should answer with attendees aged 5–16 in mind

details.label: Privacy
details.value: No name or email is needed
